scope: DIEGEO segmented planar/spatial and transformed imports into the first owner-bound alternate container; lifecycle and coexistence with direct spatial geometry. Complete application remains unfinished.
verified_behavior: Every supported owner-bound object starts with one empty alternate container and identity transform.
Planar segment imports replace committed groups by index, retain untouched trailing groups, and map internal errors to handler2.
Spatial two-field headers clear existing segments before reading, preserve transform, and ignore ordinary internal segment-reader status.
Separator rows consume numeric data without contributing to advertised count; committed earlier groups survive later failures.
Successful format2 converts sixth values of every stored segment, including retained trailing segments; early failure skips conversion.
Transformed imports consume conditional prefixes before clear, then create an empty segment; four matrix rows commit together only after all row helpers succeed.
Matrix row outputs start at zero and partial or zero-conversion scans can return success; missing-row errors preserve old matrix after the earlier segment clear.
Deactivation restores alternate identity/empty defaults; reactivation does not restore old payload. Dimension changes destroy objects, same-dimension headers preserve them.
Direct spatial geometry and alternate segments retain separate payload and flags; direct plane finalization still runs when its flag is enabled.

candidate_history.post_verification_change: CMakeLists.txt registers the two tests. Other27 frozen source/driver/library entries remain identical; receipt binds exact test-only diff and archived CTest log. No C++ correction after freeze.

preserved_diagnostic.cause: Comparator assumed every segment-clear event was within DIEGEO. Original construction and dimension cleanup also invoke clear. Corrected comparator verifies those paired lifecycle events and matrix preservation; candidate, probe and fixtures unchanged.

evidence_boundaries: Static pseudocode and supplemental dispatch assembly establish call/field semantics; runtime captures separately establish observed behavior.
The original-only audit checks provenance, scanner assignments, allocation zeroing, group commits and lifecycle. Independent corrupted-record checks test its sensitivity.
Comparison uses original raw binary64 bytes, complete represented buffers, handler and final states; pointer identities/capacities are provenance rather than cross-process ABI targets.
Prepared fixture manifests retain their pre-execution status and hypotheses as historical evidence; these completed reports supersede their pending outcomes.
limitations: Finite bounded fixtures do not prove all importer or numeric behavior.
Negative/overflowing segment extents, nonfinite/range failures and unsafe retained format1 storage visited by format2 remain explicit unsupported domains.
Additional geometry containers, shared ownership, allocation failures, transient native leaks and full downstream transformation/scientific operations remain unrecovered.
Material-empty finalization profile only; populated-material initialization, reconciliation and component remapping are the next recovery area.
Public database-loader interfaces remain unchanged; full original console/file/API replacement is not complete.
